work.description: A continuous commentary on the whole of Genesis, chapter by chapter and verse by verse, compiled in the Carolingian manner out of Jerome, Augustine, Gregory, Isidore and Bede, with the historical sense given first and the mystical after it. Migne prints it with the verse ranges the compiler himself set at the head of every block.
